entities.summary: Jaume Nomen Torres is a Spanish oral and maxillofacial surgeon, amateur astronomer, and discoverer of numerous minor planets. He is of Catalan origin and became publicly known for the discovery of the near-Earth asteroid 2012 DA14 by the OAM team during the La Sagra Sky Survey. The asteroid 56561 Jaimenomen is named after him.
